answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 20544 Country: India Title: I see in my dream that I am driving a car(when I did not know how to drive) and was thinking to myself that though I do not know driving I am able to drive it easily but there is some sort of fear in me.I have seen this many times. 2)Now I have learnt driving but not efficiently and I still see this type of dream.I saw in my dream that I have parked my car and was going somewhere leaving my friends inside.I had the keys with me and was feeling that I should have left the key with them incase of an emergency...??? Question: Dear Mufti Saab Assalamualaikum, 1)I see in my dream that I am driving a car(when I did not know how to drive) and was thinking to myself that though I do not know driving I am able to drive it easily but there is some sort of fear in me.I have seen this many times. 2)Now I have learnt driving but not efficiently and I still see this type of dream.I saw in my dream that I have parked my car and was going somewhere leaving my friends inside.I had the keys with me and was feeling that I should have left the key with them incase of an emergency.When I went back to the car I found my brother and mother sitting inside and someone in the seat next to the driver's seat.I saw a rickshaw puller had dented my car and was going away.My brother was telling me that we can claim insurance from the company and as a compensation will ask the rickshaw puller to give us rs.150 as he cannot pay more than this.He told me that he did it before in his case.I started chasing the man with my car and went to his workplace where I had stopped the car on a ramp and had a big argument with the man.He was not ready to give me money nor was he repentant.I was very hurt at his behaviour and very angry too.When I returned to my car I found my mother sitting in the drivers seat and unknowingly she pulled the hand brake and the car started moving towards the man as it was parked on a ramp.I felt scared that if the car would kill the man I would be arrested and somehow opened the door and put the brakes.I was asking who let my mother sit in the front seat and was very angry at her foolishness.When I woke up I felt very sad at being angry at my mom and was also thinking how I was able to apply brakes in a moving car from outside.What is the meaning of this dream.Please explain. Answer ID: 20544 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 508/L=157/tl=1431) The dream indicates that the worldly love abounds in you; also there is no complete implementation of veil in your home. Be regular in five times of salah and remember death extensively, as well as start reading Fazail Aamal part 1 & 2 and Muntakhab Ahadith at your home. In-sha-Allah, you will incline towards the hereafter. And the love of world gradually would continue to vanish from your heart. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
